Interface Card

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ArtistCard, BuilderCard, BuildingCard, CharacterCard, EndGameBuildingCard, EventCard, GathererCard, HunterCard, HuntEvent, InventorCard, ModifierBuildingCard, ObserverPairBuildingCard, ObserverSetBuildingCard, PaintingsEvent, RitualEvent, ShamanCard, SustenanceEvent, TribeCard
public interface Card extends Serializable
The root interface for all cards in the Mesos game. It defines the base contract for the Visitor pattern and includes Jackson annotations for polymorphic serialization.
